name: BottomNav
description: Mobile bottom tab bar for the 3-5 primary destinations of an app shell, with an active tab, count badges and safe-area padding.
designIntent: Mobile apps put primary navigation within thumb reach at the bottom of the screen, but hand-rolled bars drift on target size, active state and the iOS home indicator. BottomNav owns the landmark, the aria-current state, 44px minimum targets and env(safe-area-inset-bottom) so every mobile shell behaves the same.

props.name: items
props.description: Tabs in order: href, label, optional icon, active, badge and disabled.

props.name: linkComponent
props.description: Router link component (Next Link, react-router Link).

props.name: linkHrefProp
props.description: Prop used to pass the destination to linkComponent.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the nav landmark.

props.name: fixed
props.description: Pin the bar to the bottom edge with safe-area padding.

props.name: mobileOnly
props.description: Hide the bar from the md breakpoint up.

examples.title: Mobile app shell tabs
examples.code:
<BottomNav
  items={[
    { href: '/', label: 'Home', icon: <HomeIcon />, active: true },
    { href: '/search', label: 'Search', icon: <SearchIcon /> },
    { href: '/alerts', label: 'Alerts', icon: <BellIcon />, badge: 3 },
  ]}
/>
examples.description: Three primary destinations with one active tab.

antiPatterns.title: Don't stack more than five tabs
antiPatterns.explanation: Targets stop being thumb-reachable and labels start truncating. Move the extras into a More destination.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use BottomNav for desktop navigation
antiPatterns.explanation: mobileOnly hides the bar at md and up; desktop keeps SiteHeader/Sidebar.

accessibility.userRequirements: Give each bar a distinct label when a page has more than one nav

accessibility.implementation: aria-current="page" on the active tab only
accessibility.userRequirements: Set active from the router's current location

accessibility.implementation: Every tab is at least 56px tall with a 44px minimum target
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep icons decorative; the label carries the name

compositionRules.relationship: Pair with AppShell and add bottom padding so content is not hidden behind the bar
Counts ride in the item's badge slot; keep them to a single number
